kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
يحسوا (form I)
# يَحُسُّوا (yaḥussū) /ja.ħus.suː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of حَسَّ (ḥassa, “to freeze; to curry (a horse)”)
# يُحَسُّوا (yuḥassū) /ju.ħas.suː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of حَسَّ (ḥassa, “to freeze; to curry (a horse)”) and حَسَّ (ḥassa, “to feel, to perceive”)
# يَحِسُّوا (yaḥissū) /ja.ħis.suː/: th
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
